sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: One SNLinear with one power iteration/singular value; conv and embedding wrappers are excluded.

sourceFacts: Power vectors are estimated under no_grad, but the singular value calculation occurs outside that context.
u0 and sv0 are buffers. sv0 is for logging, whereas division uses current svs[0]; replacing the denominator by the buffer changes semantics.
Every forward normalizes W. Training controls the state writes, not whether normalization happens.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
